reading_note: The arc traces how Divine Truth calls trapped good and truth upward through three modes of summons. First the Lord, when establishing the heavens, implanted the roots of higher states within the lower natural mind by stripping their externals and casting them down — so that, at the time of regeneration, life could be drawn back up. Three calls then operate: (1) directly upon the externals of natural life, returning their good to the heavens; (2) through the five degrees of natural perception (the trees) in cooperation with angelic societies; (3) through the recovery of life trapped in the five sensual worlds, where falsity, evil, and wrath pour down and bind men to fate. The middle of the teaching explains the Wheel — that the cycle of outer states (zodiac) has no root in genuine spiritual ground but only in the boundary-sea of natural mind, because when the matrix of external truth could not grasp the descending divine call, it fell and split into three: into the cyclic, into the scientific-natural, and into the trees and flesh. Stars therefore rule fate only because fallen matter is bound there. The teaching ends with the consolation that the Father of Life draws living souls up from every region by the great root of the Tree-Cross, and concludes with the eschatological extraction of matter, which then consumes its own members.
